'''Jaral''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was a [[Major/Legends|major]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], when he was stationed on [[Vaiken Spacedock]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Major Jaral appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]], as the Balmorra Equipment Commendations vendor on Vaiken Spacedock; he was later relabeled as the Level 14 Modification Vendor. Jaral was later removed from the game along with the rest of the planetary Equipment Commendations vendors in Game Update 4.0 on [[October 20]], [[2015]].<ref name="TOR" />
